name: Nerves & pressure

overlay.caption: pressure squeezes the nerve → signals blocked → numb · pressure off → nerve restarts → pins and needles

does: Shows numbness growing the longer a nerve is pressed
Shows pins and needles starting after the pressure is off and fading within a couple of minutes
Shows signals returning to normal on their own
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Separate the nerve itself from its blood supply — both get squeezed
Cover numbness that happens without anything pressing
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Numbness or tingling that comes without sitting on something, or doesn't go away, is a reason to tell an adult.

sources: NIH NINDS: Brain basics — nerves and signals (student overview)
